name: @red-cup-engineering/polymarket-services-section
description: A sovereign venue-access settlement owning the firm's Polymarket relationship: the Polymarket US account, Ed25519 API keys, and USD/USDC funding rails. It declares public market-data feeds (the offshore gamma feed is research-only until the pending CFTC filing opens that book to US persons), admits bounded read-only data requests, and executes an admitted order request against Polymarket US's own API only under Leader-activated credentials and policy.

scripts.check: node --check src/feed.mjs && node --check src/orders.mjs && node --check src/client.mjs && node --check test/orders.test.mjs && node --check test/client.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: a bounded read-only market-data request against the declared Polymarket US feed, or an ActivityStreams order request from the event-contract-arbitrage-desk citing a qualified pair, admitted only while Leader-activated credentials and a live activation policy exist
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: any order while activation is refused or credentials are absent, credential disclosure or custody transfer, orders for another settlement, self-matching, withdrawal or transfer instructions not Leader-authorized, and cross-settlement writes
